<USER_REQUEST>
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Cinder Husk".

Creative brief
Name: Cinder Husk
Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Abandoned forge creatures and half-living constructs powered by coals, slag, chains, soot, and unstable furnace heat.
Core concept: A basic marching attacker that fires predictable volleys whenever its furnace chest opens.
Body and silhouette: Stocky humanoid shell with broad iron shoulders, short legs, and a hollow helmet.
Signature features: Furnace-door chest, glowing seams, and a chimney-like neck opening.
Palette and materials: Black iron, ash gray, ember orange, and dark crimson.
Movement personality: Rigid, tireless, and industrial.
Attack concept: Stops, opens its chest door, and fires three slow embers in a straight line before closing and advancing again.
Directional details: The left shoulder plate is larger and visibly riveted.
Avoid: Living human face, science-fiction robot, excessive flame effects obscuring the silhouette.
</USER_REQUEST>
